name: Industrial HMI controller
description: Display controller with touch, 24 V supply, fieldbus and real-time clock in an industrial enclosure.
electrical_characteristics: 24 V surge-protected input to a buck
Capacitive touch controller with EMC considerations
critical_electrical_constraints: Display bus length matching per interface
Fieldbus protection and isolation as required
stackup_recommendations: 2 or 4 layers; isolation barriers between field side and logic side
placement_rules: Field-side components grouped at the terminal blocks; isolators on the barrier; logic side separate
Relays and their drivers near the output terminals, flyback diodes at the coils
24 V input protection at the connector
routing_rules: Creepage/clearance across the isolation barrier per the rated isolation voltage
24 V and relay contact traces sized for the rated load current
Fieldbus pairs (RS-485/CAN) as 120 ohm pairs with termination at the bus end
copper_ground_requirements: No pour across barriers; field ground and logic ground separate
thermal_considerations: Relay coil and input-resistor dissipation at the maximum input voltage; derating at 60 degC ambient
emi_emc_considerations: Surge (IEC 61000-4-5) and burst (61000-4-4) immunity: TVS and series impedance at every field terminal
protection_requirements: Isolated inputs (optocoupler/digital isolator); relay or isolated MOSFET outputs
Reverse polarity and over-voltage on the 24 V supply input
verification_requirements: Isolation voltage declared; creepage per IEC 60664-1 recorded
manufacturing_constraints: Pluggable terminal blocks; conformal coating option changes the clearance condition
unsupported_conditions: Touch controller without EMC filtering near a 24 V switching supply
